# Periwinkle – GRUB theme
# Colors from themes/roxy.json. The fonts (roxy-*.pf2) are generated by
# `roxy grub` from JetBrains Mono, so they are not part of the repo.
# Layout: a labeled box with the boot menu in the center, countdown text,
# key hints and a thin progress bar below the box.

title-text: ""
desktop-color: "#0b0c1f"
terminal-font: "Roxy Mono Regular 16"
terminal-left: "10%"
terminal-top: "10%"
terminal-width: "80%"
terminal-height: "80%"
terminal-border: "0"
